summary: @onereach/or-browser preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue file-browser component but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line heavily obfuscated bundle using string-array rotation (WV8StW rotator, multi-thousand-entry lookup table, hc1jfK9 base decoder over a scrambled charset) whose name and content have no relation to the advertised Vue component. `setup.mjs` itself is written in obfuscator.io style (`_0xXXXX` identifier mangling, proxy-object string constants such as `TdVzu: "/etc/os-release"`, `gLXYX: "Alpine"`), including platform probes for Alpine/glibc. On any `npm install` of this version the obfuscated payload executes with the installer's privileges under a runtime deliberately chosen to bypass Node-based scanning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
